items.title: Natural Gas Spot Market Steadies as Buyers Capitalize on Cheap Prices
items.summary: Next-day natural gas prices advanced in most regions on Wednesday, staunching a recent bloodletting that dragged prices low enough to attract bargain buyers.

items.title: US LNG Feedgas Demand Holds October Pace Despite Freeport Train 2 Outage
items.summary: US LNG feedgas demand rose about 600 MMcf/d on Wednesday, led by a recovery at Freeport LNG, according to NGI’s Entropic Analytics data.

items.title: Full Northern Border Pipeline Pushes Gas Into Soft Chicago Market, Blowing Out Spreads
items.summary: Midwest natural gas basis discounts widened sharply after Northern Border Pipeline (NBPL) issued a high-inventory operational flow order (OFO) watch Tuesday, citing elevated pressures and limited flexibility to absorb negative imbalances.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Get Off the Ropes, Post Second Straight Gain
items.summary: Natural gas futures sustained momentum on Wednesday as production estimates held at relatively light levels and LNG demand proved durable, offsetting bearish weather patterns and expectations for a stout storage injection.

items.title: Aramco Advancing Higher Crude Output, Natural Gas Strategy Despite Iran War
items.summary: Saudi Aramco expects both seasonal and structural crude demand to rise in the months ahead as the Iran war continues to throttle Middle East energy output, which has pushed up commodity prices across the board.

items.title: Diamondback Sees Permian Natural Gas Shift to Demand-Driven Growth
items.summary: Oil and gas producer Diamondback Energy sees the Solitude natural gas pipeline coming online in the second half of 2029, adding more egress out of the Permian Basin.

items.title: Could Democrats Unlock Hormuz After Midterm Rout? LNG Markets Watching Washington
items.summary: Global energy prices fell on Wednesday after sweeping Democratic victories in the US midterm election raised the prospect that the Trump administration’s war in Iran could now be limited and a peace deal might come sooner.

items.title: Supportive Fundamental Trends Boost Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: December natural gas futures crept higher through midday trading on Wednesday, helped by rebounding LNG feedgas, downwardly trending production and slightly cooler two-week forecast trends.

items.title: MPLX Unfazed by EQT-Range Merger as Appalachian Gas Processing Nears Capacity
